# Trueline IT

> Done-for-you phone and follow-up automation for home-service businesses (plumbers, HVAC, electricians and other trades). We set it up and run it on your existing number. Call-only: (647) 360-5774.

## Core offers
- Missed-Call Text-Back: $149/mo per location plus a one-time $199 setup. When you miss a call, the caller gets a text right away, the thread captures what they need, and you're alerted. Works on your existing number. https://truelineit.com/missed-call-text-back
- AI Receptionist: $399/mo plus a one-time $499 setup. Answers calls nights, weekends and after hours, captures job requests and flags urgent calls to you. https://truelineit.com/ai-receptionist

Month-to-month, cancel anytime. 30-day money-back guarantee: if it's not right within 30 days of your first invoice and first payment, we refund your entire first invoice — the setup fee plus your first month — no questions asked.

## Add-on services (6 home-service services in total with the 2 core offers; available on their own or as an add-on)
- Google Reviews (one service, two plans, per location): Requests $79/mo plus $99 setup; Requests + Replies $99/mo plus $99 setup. Replies is a +$20/mo upgrade, not sold on its own. https://truelineit.com/google-review-requests (replies: https://truelineit.com/google-review-replies)
- Website Chat-to-Text: $79/mo plus $99 setup. https://truelineit.com/website-chat-to-text
- Text-to-Pay Invoices: $49/mo plus $99 setup. https://truelineit.com/text-to-pay
- Quote Follow-Up & Win-Back: $149/mo plus $199 setup. https://truelineit.com/quote-follow-up-win-back

For law, accounting and clinic teams that want to use AI safely, done for you: written AI use policies, checks for unapproved AI tools, Microsoft 365 Copilot setup, and staff training. PIPEDA-ready; PHIPA-ready for health practices. This is guidance and setup, not legal advice.

- Growth: $2,500/mo

https://truelineit.com/ai-governance | Pricing: https://truelineit.com/ai-consulting-pricing
